name: Odysseus v1 Private AI Workspace
description: Self-hosted AI workspace with web search, vector memory and alerts.

PORT.description: Port uvicorn listens on (0.0.0.0). Railway routes the public domain and the /api/health check here.

ODYSSEUS_ADMIN_USER.description: Username of the admin account created on first boot.

ODYSSEUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password, generated at deploy. Used only to create the admin on first boot (and by the one-time bootstrap); change it later in Settings.

AUTH_ENABLED.description: Keep true: login required for the web UI and API. false would expose shell, file and agent tools to anyone with the URL.

LOCALHOST_BYPASS.description: Keep false: loopback requests must authenticate too (upstream: development only).

DATABASE_URL.description: SQLite database for sessions, messages, documents and model endpoints, on the /app/data volume.

CHROMADB_HOST.description: Private hostname of the ChromaDB vector store (memory vectors, RAG, semantic skills).

CHROMADB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds for the ChromaDB connect probe at startup.

SEARXNG_INSTANCE.description: Private SearXNG URL used for web search and deep research.

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.description: Private URL of the bundled Ollama service. Registered as a model endpoint on first boot.

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Tuned Ollama model registered on first boot; it becomes the default chat model unless LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL is set or you picked another default.

LLM_PROVIDER_API_KEY.description: Optional, recommended for fast answers. API key of an OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, ...). When set, the provider is registered as a model endpoint on boot. More providers can be added in Settings.

LLM_PROVIDER_BASE_URL.description: Optional. OpenAI-compatible base URL for LLM_PROVIDER_API_KEY, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL.description: Optional. Model id on that provider (e.g. gpt-5-mini, or openai/gpt-5-mini on OpenRouter). When set it becomes the default chat model instead of the local Ollama model; otherwise pick a model in the chat model menu.

NTFY_INTERNAL_URL.description: Private ntfy URL. Added as the ntfy integration for reminders on first boot.

NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN.description: Write-only ntfy access token Odysseus publishes reminders with (stored encrypted in Odysseus).

NTFY_TOPIC.description: ntfy topic for reminders and alerts. Subscribe to it in the ntfy app.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Exact origins allowed for cross-origin API clients.

OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL.description: External origin for remote MCP server OAuth callbacks.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI.description: Gmail OAuth redirect URI (Railway's proxy is not on a trusted address, so it is pinned here). Only used if you connect Gmail.

FASTEMBED_MODEL.description: Local ONNX embedding model for memory and documents (upstream default, runs on CPU).

FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH.description: Embedding model cache on the volume, so it is downloaded once.

CLEANUP_INTERVAL_HOURS.description: Interval of the built-in cleanup job.

WAIT_FOR_SERVICES_SECONDS.description: How long the start script waits for ChromaDB before starting Odysseus anyway.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period for in-flight requests and SQLite writes on redeploy.

PORT.description: ChromaDB HTTP port (private). Railway's healthcheck probes /api/v2/heartbeat here.

ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY.description: Chroma product telemetry off (as in upstream compose).

PORT.description: SearXNG port (granian, dual-stack ::). Railway's healthcheck probes /healthz here.

SEARXNG_SECRET.description: SearXNG secret key (overrides server.secret_key), generated at deploy.

SEARXNG_BASE_URL.description: Base URL SearXNG uses for its own links (private network only).

PORT.description: ntfy HTTP port. Railway routes the public domain and the /v1/health check here.

NTFY_BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this ntfy server: use it as the server in the ntfy app.

NTFY_BEHIND_PROXY.description: Trust Railway's proxy headers for client IPs (rate limiting).

NTFY_ADMIN_USER.description: ntfy login for the web app and the Android/iOS app.

NTFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of NTFY_ADMIN_USER, generated at deploy.

NTFY_ODYSSEUS_TOKEN.description: Access token of the write-only 'odysseus' publisher user (ntfy format tk_ + 29 chars). Odysseus reads it by reference.

NTFY_AUTH_FILE.description: User and access-control database, on the volume.

NTFY_AUTH_DEFAULT_ACCESS.description: Anonymous users can neither read nor publish.

NTFY_ENABLE_LOGIN.description: Show the login in the ntfy web app.

NTFY_REQUIRE_LOGIN.description: The web app is only usable after login.

NTFY_CACHE_FILE.description: Message cache on the volume, so phones that were offline still get alerts after a redeploy.

NTFY_CACHE_DURATION.description: How long messages are kept for clients that were offline.

NTFY_UPSTREAM_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Set https://ntfy.sh for instant iOS push (ntfy.sh then relays a wake-up poll with only the message ID). Android and web need nothing.

OLLAMA_BASE_MODEL.description: Library model pulled on first boot (1.4 GB, Q4_K_M, tool calling, CPU-friendly).

OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Tuned copy of OLLAMA_BASE_MODEL that Odysseus uses: CPU thread count, OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH and (for qwen3) thinking off. Recreated on every start.

OLLAMA_THINKING.description: false: qwen3 answers directly, without a hidden reasoning phase (much faster on CPU). true: keep the model's own template, so qwen3 reasons before every answer. Redeploy Ollama after changing.

OLLAMA_NUM_THREAD.description: Optional. CPU threads for inference. Empty: this service's CPU quota, at most 8 (more threads than granted CPU time stall generation on shared hosts).

OLLAMA_GO_TEMPLATE.description: Render chats with each model's Modelfile TEMPLATE (needed for the thinking-off template; otherwise Ollama may use the GGUF's embedded template).

OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.description: Context window (num_ctx): room for Odysseus' tool instructions, memory and search results.

OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION.description: Flash attention, needed for the quantized KV cache below.

OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE.description: 8-bit KV cache: halves context memory with little quality loss.

OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.description: One request at a time (CPU); keeps memory predictable.

OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE.description: Unload the model after 30 idle minutes to free RAM.
